rotation: real PTY/ConPTY, terminal emulation, TUI control, structured terminal evidence, agent-first terminal sessions, terminal-use benchmarks

capabilityGap.current: Ferrum process targets use pipe stdio with bounded lifecycle, health, log assertions, write-stdin, close-stdin, HTTP requests, wait-exit and diagnostics.
capabilityGap.missing: Real PTY/ConPTY allocation plus terminal cells, cursor, modes, resize, alternate-screen, special-key semantics and PTY-specific cleanup proof.
capabilityGap.reason: Pipe-backed testing cannot prove behavior that exists only when an application detects and renders to a real terminal.

deepInspection.conclusion: The TUI gap is material, but direct node-pty adoption is not yet justified. Compare a narrow subprocess PTY/terminal bridge against Termless as semantic oracle and treat Windows cleanup as a mandatory acceptance item.
deepInspection.reasonNoProductChange: No candidate has completed a repeated real Linux+Windows identical-workload PTY lifecycle and terminal-state comparison under Ferrum.
